items.head: Only lend what you can lose
items.sub: Not sure you'd be fine if it never comes back? Say no.

items.head: Never co-sign someone's debt
items.sub: Their missed payments become your problem.

items.head: Don't announce your income
items.sub: Or your savings, or plans that haven't happened yet.

items.head: Don't pry into theirs
items.sub: Salary, age, relationship status. Let them offer.

items.head: Lead with results
items.sub: Tell your boss what got done first, then the problems.

items.head: Never trash your boss
items.sub: Even your closest coworker can repeat it.

items.head: Ask in private, not the group chat
items.sub: Don't put someone on the spot in front of everyone.

items.head: Pay back every favor
items.sub: He bought dinner? The next one is on you.

label: RULE 9
head: Never decide angry
sub: No quitting, buying or signing anything until you've slept on it.

text: Be kind, but hold your ground. Kindness *without a backbone* gets used.

head: Save this *for later*
sub: Send it to the friend who needs rule 2.
